concerns: The reading for 散 (ち) in entry 10 is incorrect. The kanji 散 can be read as ちらす (chirasu) or ちらばる (chirabaru) when followed by らす, but not ちらす (chirasu) as a standalone reading for 散. It should be 散らす (ちらす).
The reading for 気晴 (きば) in entry 11 is incomplete. The full reading for 気晴らし should be きばらし.
